title: Unify single-time command helpers to SubmitInfo2 + Sync2 stages
purpose: Avoid mixed legacy submits and ensure consistent barriers/stages for BLAS/TLAS builds and mip blits.

steps.detail: Add helpers that record cmds and submit via VkSubmitInfo2, specifying command buffer submit info and (optional) timeline waits/signals.
Replace legacy vkQueueSubmit/vkQueueWaitIdle calls in MeshParticleRenderer and VolumeRenderer with Context's SubmitInfo2 helpers.
Use appropriate src/dst stage masks for: COMPUTE/AS_BUILD/TRANSFER/ALL_GRAPHICS when enqueuing work.

acceptance: Stable builds and mip generation with Synchronization2
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('Synchronization2 pipeline stages for AS build and blit')
notes: Ensure queue ownership is correct; avoid device-wide waits; prefer per-submit waits.
